title: Chronic Traffic Violations
description: Use this service request to report traffic violations that reoccur such as speeding, using cell phones in an active school zone, street racing and red light/traffic sign violations at/in a specific area or location. NOT for PARKING violations. NOTE: For emergencies call 9-1-1. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

detailsForm.intro: ***Be advised that this service request is not monitored on a 24-hour basis. If you have an emergency and require immediate assistance, please call 911.***

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to report recurring traffic violations.
actions.why: To report recurring or repeat traffic violations at a specific location, including speeding, street racing, red-light or traffic-sign violations, and cell-phone use in an active school zone. The 311 request form asks whether the problem recurs, the violation type, whether it occurs on weekdays during the day, weekday evenings, or weekends, and details about people, vehicles, times, or days.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Chronic Traffic Violations" requests does not apply to parking violations. If the condition is an emergency or needs immediate assistance, then call 911 instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Chronic Traffic Violations"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Chronic Traffic Violations"

actions.tagline: Call emergency dispatch for an emergency involving traffic violations.
actions.why: For a traffic-violation emergency or a situation requiring immediate assistance; the Dallas 311 website says this request is not monitored on a 24-hour basis.
